retrospective secondary analysis with rules fixed before that analysis and prior knowledge disclosed; independence not established

nonqualifying_shortcuts: new timestamp alone does not establish past independence
unknown-exposure data plus a new split/CV/bootstrap does not establish independence
new analyst or independent recomputation does not remove original design knowledge
custody imposed now cannot repair past unknown exposure
new file name/version/DOI or redownload of same measurements does not create new data identity
different farm cannot silently replace current within-site E1

basis concerning use in design or selection
